text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Lumenix renewal stuck. Procurement says they can sign but finance flagged a third-party vendor code requirement and want invoice issued to a different EU billing entity. They put procurement on hold until we reissue the invoice and attach the new PO.
alex_renewals: ugh, ok. do we have the new billing entity details? vendor code? :eyes:
maria_cs: they sent this in email: Vendor: Lumenix GmbH (DE), VAT ID DE123456789, Billing entity: Lumenix EU Operations GmbH. PO number they expect: PO-7293-EU. They also asked for Net45 instead of Net30 — legal may need to approve term change.
paul_billing: I can reissue the invoice, but need confirm of currency and prorate. do we keep the current commit and prorate to new invoice? also which account number to use for tax line?
maria_cs: keep the commit, prorate the remaining months. currency stays EUR. tax line should reference the new VAT id above. I can share the customer's email chain if needed.
jen_legal: Net45 is ok for most renewals but need a quick approval since it's a term deviation. @alex_renewals send me the justification (customer hardship + procurement policy) and i'll sign off today if it's documented.
sam_sales: sending justification now — customer is switching billing entity for compliance with local finance. already promised Net45 to close. cc @maria_cs
alex_renewals: pushing docs to jen: "Request: Net45 for Lumenix GmbH due to local AP cycle. PO-7293-EU attached. Billing entity updated to Lumenix EU Operations GmbH (VAT DE123456789)." Please ack when approved.
jen_legal: ack, approved. i'll add the clause to the order form and initial with legal signoff. small ask: include clause for invoice reissuance referencing original invoice #INV-4242 to avoid duplicate payments.
paul_billing: cool. i'll generate new invoice referencing INV-4242 and include PO-7293-EU. will change payment term to Net45 and VAT line to "DE123456789". anyone want to review before i send to docusign?
maria_cs: please send to me first, i'll confirm with customer contact.
paul_billing: draft attached (pdf) -> https://files.redwood.dev/drafts/Lumenix_invoice_PO-7293.pdf
maria_cs: looks good. one more thing — procurement insisted the signer on DocuSign must be the CFO (Helga Meyer). current signer on order form is Head of Ops. need to update signer and re-send.
docusign-bot: Notice: Envelope 0a9f... created for Lumenix; current signer: Klaus (Head Ops). Pending update to signer role: CFO (Helga Meyer).
paul_billing: ok will swap signer role in the envelope. new envelope will go to Helga at helga@lumenix.eu. sending now.
paul_billing: sent — envelope 0b3c... with updated signer. I also added a note referencing PO-7293-EU and original invoice #INV-4242.
maria_cs: pinging customer contact to expect DocuSign. thanks all — i'll update the renewal tracker once signed. :thumbsup:
sam_sales: great — let me know if we need to push to their procurement contact.
maria_cs: will do. if signature clears today we keep the original renewal date; if not, need to scope a one-week SLA for seat provisioning change. will update AC accordingly.
alex_renewals: thanks team — nice coordination. "PO header example" for billing to pass to finance:
```
PO: PO-7293-EU
Billing entity: Lumenix EU Operations GmbH
VAT: DE123456789
Currency: EUR
Term: Net45
Reference invoice: INV-4242
```
maria_cs: saved. closing loop once signed. """
